pages.text: File: serverconfig/creativeforge-server.toml in the world folder.$(li)[creative_crate], [creative_fluid_tank], [creative_motor]: enabled, cap$(li)[creative_blaze_cake], [worldshaper]: enabled$(li)strictAudit (default false)

At server start every recipe is checked. One that makes a creative item outside mechanical crafting is logged as an error, because the cap cannot see it. With $(l)strictAudit$() on, the server refuses to start instead.
